_meta.purpose: Hand-labelled regression set for Muraqib's assessment engine.
_meta.labelling_note: Expected statuses were assigned by reading the declared evidence against the control's assessment question. Cases with no declared evidence are labelled not_assessable on purpose - abstention is the correct behaviour, and measuring it stops the engine drifting toward confident guessing.
_meta.how_to_extend: Add a case with a platform config, a control id and the status a careful human reviewer would assign. Keep the ratio of not_assessable and non_compliant cases high; over-claiming is the failure mode that matters.
_meta.revision_note: v1.1 (2026-09-05) added 8 cases built from the failure modes found by running the system end to end: present-tense evidence the token list was blind to, the noun/verb ambiguity that reverted the base-form verb expansion, the pattern-only partial cap, and two roadmap-as-control traps. Cases were labelled first and the engine run afterwards.

cases.note: Evidence is entirely present tense and describes a gate operating. The token list scored it 0/0 and abstained, which was wrong. It is labelled partial rather than compliant on two independent grounds: the control also asks about training and fine-tuning data and about representativeness, neither of which the evidence covers; and grammatical role inferred from a neighbouring token is weaker than an explicit claim.
